author: everestmcarthur
install_msg: Welcome to **EveCogs**! Use `[p]cog list` to see available cogs.
name: EveCogs
short: A collection of advanced cogs for Red-DiscordBot.
description: EveCogs is a premium cog repository featuring NexusCore (the ultimate all-in-one server management cog with tickets, applications, suggestions, reaction roles, giveaways, logging, moderation & economy), Wormhole v3.3.0 (cross-server relay), and NewHelpMenu (Components V2 help overhaul).
